overview: A nonchalant clown explores the surreal landscape they were spawned into, a landscape created through the fabric of the digital, one that exists in the world of an American sitcom. As they find themselves falling asleep, it appears they have re-spawned into a new, yet familiar landscape in which they are eager to explore with a curious and positive mindset. They face grotesque obstacles in this nightmare that they register as fun moments that continue the plot due to their aloof nature. This is until they ultimately encounter death and meet with their God, Flumbus who is ready to give them a new life.
title: Chill Jill
